import sys

def fast_exponentiation(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

MODULUS_VALUE = 10**9 + 7

for line in sys.stdin:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    p_str, k_str = line.strip().split()
    p = int(p_str)
    k = int(k_str)
    if k == 0:
        print(fast_exponentiation(p, p - 1, MODULUS_VALUE))
        continue
    if k == 1:
        print(fast_exponentiation(p, p, MODULUS_VALUE))
        continue
    visited = [False] * p
    total_cycles = 0
    for i in range(1, p):
        if visited[i]:
            continue
        j = i
        cycle_size = 0
        while not visited[j]:
            visited[j] = True
            j = (j * k) % p
            cycle_size += 1
        if fast_exponentiation(k, cycle_size, p) == 1:
            total_cycles += 1
    print(fast_exponentiation(p, total_cycles, MODULUS_VALUE))
